approaches.name: FundsChain blockchain platform for real-time disbursement tracking
approaches.description: World Bank offers borrower a blockchain platform tracking disbursements in real time, at no cost.
approaches.why_innovative: New process: blockchain real-time disbursement tracking - cue: 'innovative' | category Financial; adoption prospect; judged in 1 round(s); final check: digital core, rare_or_absent before 2019

evidence.text: As part of its commitment to enhancing transparency and accountability in project financing, the World Bank is offering borrowers and clients access to FundsChain, an innovative blockchain-based platform that optimizes real-time tracking of disbursements and complements existing financial management systems in support of digitization, transparency, and efficiency.

extra_evidence.text: The platform has been introduced to the client and is available at no additional cost.
The borrower is encouraged to adopt the platform, which can be customized to align with existing financial management systems and the project’s operational context.

category.rationale: Financial: changes how project funds are tracked and disbursed

adoption.rationale: Digital core: blockchain disbursement tracker | Innovative: real-time tracking beyond standard FM | Category: financial transparency
